title: Rails of Ruun
description: Large 3ft gauge track pack including multiple ballast materials and track models.
body:
Rails of Ruun requires Immersive Railroading to function properly

RAILS OF RUUN

Rails of Ruun seeks to add detailed, immersive track models that blend well into a vanilla aesthetic. Elevate your Immersive Railroading 3ft gauge network with detailed turntables, bridges, and embankments in 13 base game inspired material pallets!

CONTENTS

Track Types - Standard track - One sided catch rail track - Dual catch rail track - Ballasted tracks - Ballasted ends - Ballasted transitions - Embankments - Embanked transitions - Abutments - Abutments with catch rails - Trestle pieces - Plate girder bridges - Turntables - Turntable pitsComes in Blue, White, and Construction Orange Ballast Types - Gravel - Coal - Deepslate - Diorite - Dirt - Granite - Red sand - Sand - Snow - Prismarine - Netherrack - Soulsand - Endstone - Purpur Paint Colors for Bridges and Turntables - Steel - Brown - Crimson - Green - Navy - Teal

NOTES

This pack is done as a hobby and will be updated inconsistently and as I see fit. Usage and redistribution in any form is allowed, just credit Iron Horse Dev Group and link back here in some form =) Discord Patreon Iron Horse Dev Group
